critique
# Review of the annotation of the tabloid passage: what to change in the instruction

The costliest errors come from three things the instruction does not cover:
- **Quoted headlines** were parsed as clauses instead of being treated as titled works.
- **Chinese adjectives** were not treated as PropBank stative verbs.
- **Some connective and postposition rules** in the instruction disagree with gold.

The patterns are listed from most to least costly.

---

### 1. A quoted headline counted as an article was parsed as a clause (largest cost)
**Pattern.** A headline in 「 」 was the object of a publishing or reporting verb and was counted by a classifier (一篇). The annotator analysed the words inside the quotes as events. It created `implicit-argument` plus `:topic` event, inner verbs, inner country and person names, `:quote` edges, and modal and temporal triples for them. It also built coreference chains through the headline's inner nouns. The same happened with a headline placed in apposition after an article noun (新闻 「…」).

Gold treats each such headline as a **`publication` named entity**:
- one `:op` per token, with the opening and closing quotation marks and the internal punctuation each as its own `:op`;
- the classifier's `:quant 1 :unit 篇` goes on that publication node;
- when the headline follows an article noun, the noun takes `:ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 publication)` with `:aspect state`, and that `identity-91` gets the author modal triple.

**Cost.** f_name_tokens (3 names missing). a_entity_concept (3 wrong). About 6 extra entity nodes. Several extra or wrong core-argument, `:topic` and `:purpose` units. Extra re-entrancies (`:quote`, re-entered agent). About 8 extra modal triples, about 4 extra temporal triples, and the whole extra coreference chain (j_coref precision 56).

**Why.** Section 2.2 gives the title-bracket rule only for 《 》. The quote rule in section 3 tells the annotator to parse any reported content as events. Nothing separates a headline used as a countable object from a reported clause.

**Change.** Add to 2.2:
> A headline or title in quotation marks (「 」, “ ”) that is counted by a classifier (一篇, 一则) or set in apposition to an article noun (新闻, 文章, 报导) names a work. Write it as `publication` + `:name`, with one `:op` per token, including the quotation marks and inner punctuation. Do not analyse its words: no events, no inner names, no `:quote`, no triples, no coreference into it. Put the classifier's `:quant`/`:unit` on the publication node. An article noun before it takes `:ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 publication)` (state, author full-affirmative).
>
> Only a quoted clause directly after a verb of saying, with no classifier, is reported content (section 3).

### 2. Chinese adjectives were left as plain modifiers or put under `have-mod-91`
**Pattern.** Chinese property words (ridiculous, absurd, laughable, true, prominent) were handled in two wrong ways:
- in predicate position: `have-mod-91` with the adjective as a bare `:ARG2`;
- as attributive modifiers: `:mod` with no sense.

Gold makes each one an event with its PropBank sense (`-01`). Its only role is `:ARG0`, the thing described. It has `:aspect state`, an `:overlap` temporal parent, and `(author :full-affirmative)`. An attributive one is written `noun :ARG0-of (adj-01 :aspect state)`. A property of a noun that follows 的 (the absurdity of X) is `adj-01 :ARG0 X`, not `:possessor`.

**Cost.** b_event_sense (5). c_aspect (4 missing). d_core_args (3 missing `:ARG0`, plus the wrong `have-mod-91` abstract arguments). About 5 missing temporal triples and about 5 missing modal triples. Extra `:mod` and `:possessor` edges. 1 missing re-entrancy.

**Why.** Section 2.3 says "X is Adj (no frame) → have-mod-91" and lists "plain modifiers" as non-events. The annotator did not look up adjectives in PropBank, because the required lookup reads as being for verbs only. Chinese PropBank frames most adjectives as single-argument verbs (`荒唐-01`, `显著-01`, `真实-01`, `荒谬-01` and `可笑-01` all have `ARG0` = the entity described).

**Change.** Add to the required lookup:
> Look up every Chinese adjective, predicative or attributive, in PropBank. If it has a frame, it is an event `adj-01` whose `:ARG0` is the thing described (as an attribute: `noun :ARG0-of adj-01`). Give it `:aspect state`, `:overlap` with its governing event, and an author modal triple. Use `have-mod-91` only when the word has no frame.

### 3. Ability noun with a content verb, and the 有 sense
**Pattern.** For "has the ability to V", the annotator used `有-01` with `:purpose V`, and put V's modal under 有. Gold uses `有-06` (entity described / thing it has). The ability noun takes `:ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 V :aspect state)`. V is `habitual`, and the modal triple is `(author :neutral-affirmative V)`.

**Change.**
> An ability, right or opportunity noun with a content verb (能力/机会/权利 + V) links the content as `noun :ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 V)`, never as `:purpose`. Give V `habitual` when it states a general capacity. Its modal parent is the author with `neutral-affirmative`, not 有.

Also add 有-06 (an entity described as having a feature or capacity) to the 有 trap list.

### 4. Sense and lemma lookup was not followed (b_event_sense 61)
**Pattern.**
- `当-01` was used where the participants called for `当-02` (position holder / position).
- `指-01` was used where they called for `指-02` (point out / claim).
- The token 贴到 was cut down to 贴, even though `贴到-01` exists. Its roles are `ARG1` = the place and `ARG2` = the thing posted, so the annotator's arguments were swapped too.
- For `刊登-01`, `ARG1` is the location and `ARG2` is the thing published. The annotator swapped them as well.

**Why.** The instruction already requires looking up the whole token and comparing all senses, but the annotator applied it to only a few verbs.

**Change.** Keep the rule and make it stricter:
> Before writing any Chinese concept, write out the token's full roleset list. The `-01` sense is chosen only if its role descriptions fit. For posting and publishing verbs, check which number holds the location and which holds the item; they are often `ARG1` = location and `ARG2` = item.

Give 当-02 and 指-02 as examples of a later sense being the correct one.

### 5. Postposition time nodes, named events and 如 "for example"
**Pattern.**
- **Named event with 时.** For a year plus a famous event plus 时, the annotator built a `时` node with an event and a separate date. Gold writes one `event` named entity: `:name` holds the year, 年 and the event noun as `:op`s, it attaches as `:temporal` on the clause's verb, and it gets no date triple.
- **Clause with 时.** For a clause plus 时, gold attaches the clause's event directly as `:temporal` and makes no 时 node.
- **Sentence-initial 如.** The annotator ignored a sentence-initial 如 (for example). Gold reifies it as `(have-example-91 :ARG1 (implicit-predicate) :ARG2 main-event)`, with no aspect and no triples.

**Cost.** Wrong and extra concepts, a missing name, wrong `:temporal` attachments, and 3 or 4 temporal units.

**Change.**
- Limit the 时/中 postposition-node rule in 2.1 to bare time or period nouns. When the item before 时 is a verb or clause, the event itself is the `:temporal`.
- A specific named occasion (a year + election, a games) is `event` + `:name`, with all its tokens as `:op`s.
- Add the 如 / 例如 opening-a-sentence rule as described above.

### 6. Temporal structure of reported and coordinated clauses (h_temporal 47)
**Pattern.**
- **Anchor on a time in the content.** The annotator anchored the reporting verb to a date inside the reported material. Gold links it `(document-creation-time :before reporting verb)`.
- **Earlier event in a claim.** A claim that refers to an earlier event (with its own earlier year) should be `(claim-verb :before content)`. The annotator instead made the content `:overlap` its date.
- **Order of a means or reason clause.** A means or reason sub-event of that content is `:overlap` with it, not `:before`.
- **Coordinated conjuncts.** Gold chains each conjunct to the previous one, not every conjunct to the first.
- **Defunct subject.** In the concessive sentence, the subject no longer exists, so gold dates its state `:before` the document creation time. The annotator used `:overlap`. The instruction already has this rule; it was not followed.

**Change.**
- Anchor rule (1) applies only to a time expression of the main clause itself. A date inside reported content does not anchor the reporting verb.
- An event in reported content that happened earlier than the report is `:before` the reporting verb.
- Make the "something that no longer exists → past" rule explicit for properties of that entity (its content, its staff).

### 7. Purpose connective 为了 + clause
**Pattern.** The annotator followed the instruction: `have-purpose-91` with `:aspect state`, an author triple, no re-entered subject, and `讽刺` as `process`. Gold uses `have-reason-91`, gives it no aspect and no modal triple, and re-enters the subject as `:ARG0` of the purpose verb. The purpose verb is `performance`, since it was realised together with the main event.

**Change.**
- The reified clause-linking node gets no `:aspect` and no modal triple.
- A purpose clause with no subject of its own re-enters the main subject; this overrides the "do not re-enter into 为了" line.
- A purpose that was carried out takes the main event's aspect.
- Gold may prefer `have-reason-91` here. This rests on one sentence, so state it with care.

### 8. Modal parents in reported content
**Pattern.** Gold is not fully consistent here.
- In the coordinated reporting sentence, gold puts the **reporting verbs** under the publication as conceiver: `(author → publication)` and `(publication → each reporting verb)`. The content events go under the author.
- In later sentences, gold gives the pronoun or publication no modal triple at all.
- The annotator added `(author :full-affirmative entity)` plus content-under-entity in every sentence, and an `:unspecified` triple from a support verb to its complement. Gold gives that complement no modal parent.

**Change (low priority).** Do not add the speaker-as-conceiver structure when the "content" is a titled work (pattern 1). Do not treat ordinary transitive verbs (support, endorse) as complement-taking modal predicates.

### 9. Coreference target and generic nouns
**Pattern.**
- The annotator linked a later full-noun mention to the immediately preceding pronoun. Gold links pronouns and later mentions to the **nearest earlier full-noun mention** of the entity.
- The annotator chained a generic kind noun ("aliens") across sentences. Gold leaves it unlinked.

**Change.** In 5.3:
> Link each new mention to the closest earlier mention that is a noun or name, not a pronoun. Generic kind nouns (bare nouns naming a class, especially inside quoted or fictional content) get no coreference.

### 10. Smaller items
- **Single-token compounds.** Keep a single segmented token as one concept (墙上, 记者团). The modifier-split and postposition rules apply only to separate tokens.
- **Named legislative bodies.** A legislative chamber named as a location is `building`.
- **Event modifying a noun with 的.** An event noun modifying a content noun with 的 (a photo of a handshake) is `:mod`, not `:topic`.
- **Owning country.** A country that owns an institutional thing (its policy) is `:possessor`. Keep `:place` for location. The instruction's "X 的 N → :place" rule is too broad.
- **Domain noun.** A domain noun on a policy-type noun (foreign policy) is `:topic`.
- **Agent noun with a disposition verb.** In a V者 agent noun with a disposition verb (好事者), the verb is `state`, not `habitual`.
- **Complement of a support verb.** A position verb under a support verb gets no `:aspect`.
- **`:quote` placement.** Gold puts `:quote` on every event of the claimed content, including its reason sub-event. Do not put `:quote` on the content of a plain report verb whose object is a titled work.

---

### Keep these (they were scored correct)
- Event and entity detection, granularity, `:refer-*` values on pronouns, and the document format. These scored 100 or close to it.
- A pronoun for a publication becomes a pronoun node linked `:same-entity` to the publication.
- `该刊` is written `刊 :mod 该`, and 内容 / 编辑 are `:part-of` / `:possessor` of the publication.
- `but-91` for 虽然…但; V者 decomposition; `全 :mod`; classifier `:quant`/`:unit`; and the `复制人` split.
- Most aspects of completed past acts (`performance`), and `(document-creation-time :before main event)` anchoring for narrative sentences.
reflect（说明和提出的修改）
Additions in summary:
- **Quoted headlines.** A headline in quotation marks that is counted by a classifier, or that follows an article noun, becomes a `publication` named entity. Its words are not analysed. This was the largest cost.
- **Chinese adjectives.** Every Chinese adjective, predicative or attributive, must be looked up. A framed one becomes a state event with `:ARG0` the thing described. `have-mod-91` is only for frameless words.
- **Ability nouns and 有.** An ability, right or opportunity noun with a content verb links through `identity-91`, not `:purpose`. 有-06 joins the 有 trap list.
- **Clause + 时.** The clause's event is `:temporal` directly, with no 时 node.
- **Named occasions.** They become `event` + `:name`.
- **如 "for example".** A sentence-initial 如 becomes `have-example-91`.
- **Reported content (temporal).** A date inside reported content does not anchor the reporting verb. An earlier event inside the content is `:before` the reporting verb.
- **Clause-linking `have-reason-91` / `have-purpose-91`.** These no longer get `:aspect` or a modal triple. A subjectless purpose clause re-enters the main subject, and a realised purpose takes the main event's aspect.
- **Coreference target.** Links go to the nearest earlier noun or name mention, not to a pronoun.

- the role lists in section 3;
- the `:degree`/`:quant` bullets in 4.2;
- the zero-alignment examples in section 6.

反思 3：18/19 处修改应用上，重标 85.4，保留（v12）
critique
Below are the error patterns, most costly first. Unit counts are approximate. They come from the judge's list of units it did not count as correct.

---

### 1. Reported speech by a publication: modal parents, temporal chaining and `:quote` (about 15 units: i_modal 7, h_temporal 5, g_reentrancy 3, j_coref 2)

There are three separate problems.

**a. Modal parent of the reporting verbs versus their content.**
- **Gold:** when an expressed organization or publication reports, claims or retracts something, the gold makes that entity the conceiver of its own reporting acts (`entity :full-affirmative report-verb`). The reported content events sit directly under `author`.
- **Annotator:** it did the reverse (`author → report-verb`, `entity → content`). That is what the instruction literally says in 5.2.
- The gold pattern goes against the general guidelines and may not be consistent across documents. Before rewriting 5.2, check more gold documents (search_annotations with `:full-affirmative` + a publication speaker).
- If the pattern holds, add this rule: *"When an expressed organization or publication is the agent of a series of reporting acts, that entity is the modal parent of the reporting events; their content events are under `author`; an argument clause nested inside the content (e.g. *someone becomes X*) gets no modal triple."*

**b. Temporal chaining in coordination and inside content.** Three rules to add:
- In a multi-clause `and`, each later conjunct `:overlap`s the conjunct just before it (a chain), not the first conjunct.
- An event nominal or modifier inside a noun phrase that is under another modifier event takes that nearer event as its parent, not the clause verb.
- A means or support event introduced by 靠/凭 (*by means of X*) `:overlap`s the event it enables, not `:before`.
- Also: a date expression that appears only inside reported content gets no temporal triple at all. The instruction says the anchor must not link to such a date, but it doesn't say the date itself gets no triple.

**c. `:quote` and coreference in content.**
- `:quote` goes on every event of the reported content, including subordinate reason or means events inside it, not only the top content event.
- Two mentions of a generic kind noun (a bare plural class such as *aliens* used generically) in different clauses are separate nodes with **no** `:same-entity` link. Add this to 5.3. It also stops the core-argument mix-up that a coref link causes when nodes are matched.

### 2. Demonstrative + noun written as one token (该X, 此X, 本X) (about 9 units: a_entity_concept 4, d_peripheral 2, plus knock-on temporal and peripheral errors from bad node matching)

- **Error:** the annotator kept the token as one entity concept.
- **Gold:** splits it into the noun with the demonstrative as `:mod` (`(k / 刊 :mod (g / 该))`).
- **Cause:** 2.6 says to split "free head noun + modifier" compounds, but only gives a noun-noun example. Demonstratives are listed under "not events" and look as if they get no node at all.
- **Fix:** add *"A demonstrative + noun token (该/此/本/这 + noun) is split: noun `:mod` demonstrative. Coref links the noun node."*

### 3. Frames and role numbers not taken from the whole token (about 10 units: event concept 2, sense 2, core labels 4, core args 2)

- **Verb + complement tokens.** The annotator cut such tokens (V出, V到) down to the bare verb even though the whole token has its own frame. The instruction already says to look up the whole token, so this rule was not followed. Strengthen it: *"Check V+complement tokens (V出, V到, V上, V成) as a whole first; use the bare verb only if the whole token is not in PropBank."*
- **Publishing and posting verbs.** In these frames the place is often `:ARG1` and the thing published or posted is `:ARG2`. The annotator used the English order (thing = `:ARG1`). The current sentence ("usually make the place … a numbered argument") is too vague. Replace it with: *"For publishing/posting verbs, copy the role numbers from the frame. Typically ARG1 = location/medium and ARG2 = entity published or posted."*
- **Sense choice for common polysemous verbs.** The annotator defaulted to -01 again:
  - a "serve as / hold a position" verb should be the position-holder sense;
  - a "point out / claim" verb used for a saying should be the claim sense, not the "refer to" sense.
  
  Add: *"For a verb of saying, pick the claim/assert sense. For 'serve as [title]', pick the position-holder sense."*
- Don't chase the gold's -00 on verbs that do have a PropBank frame. It doesn't generalize.

### 4. Role noun with a possessive pronoun or owner (其编辑, *its editors*) (about 6 units: extra event and entity, core args, 4 reentrancies)

- **Error:** the annotator built `person :ARG1-of have-org-role-91 :ARG2 org :ARG3 editor`.
- **Gold:** keeps the noun itself, with the owner as `:possessor`, and re-enters that noun as the agent of later verbs.
- **Fix:** limit reification to role nouns that appear with a person's name or in an explicit title construction. Add *"A role or occupation noun with only a possessor (its/其 X, the paper's X) is the noun itself + `:possessor`, not a reified role."*

### 5. A 为了 purpose clause before the main clause (about 6 units)

- **Concept:** the gold used `have-reason-91` for 为了 + clause. Check other gold before changing the concept.
- **Aspect and modal:** the reified node had no `:aspect` and no modal triple. Change 2.5: the reified reason/purpose node gets **no `:aspect`** and **no modal triple**.
- **Purpose verb:** the purpose verb is `performance` when the main act that serves the purpose is completed (not `process`). It re-enters the shared subject as `:ARG0`. This reverses the current "do not re-enter the subject into 为/为了-purpose clauses" rule for the case where the purpose clause comes before the main clause and shares its subject.

### 6. Concessive and contrast anchoring, and stance verbs (about 4 units)

- **But-91 anchor:** when the root is `but-91`/`contrast-91`, its `:ARG1` is the anchor and `:ARG2` `:overlap`s it, as with the first conjunct of `and`.
- **Tense:** descriptions of a publication or institution that the document treats as past are `:before` the document creation time. The rule already exists (the past rule in 5.1), but it was not applied to the anchor.
- **`identity-91` aspect:** under 能力/机会 the `identity-91` gets `:aspect state`. Make this an explicit exception to "nested abstract predicates get no aspect".
- **Stance verbs:** support, oppose or favour as a stance (*X supports Y doing Z*) is `state`, not `activity`. Add these to the stative list in 4.1.

### 7. 时 after a named occasion (about 3 units)

- **Error:** the annotator built a 时 node with `:op1` the named event and gave it a date triple. It then became the anchor's parent.
- **Fix:** add to 2.1: *"After a named occasion (event + `:name`), 时 gets no node; the event is the `:temporal` of the verb directly; the verb anchors to the document creation time."*

### 8. Smaller patterns (1–3 units each)

- **Sentence-initial 如 / 例如 / *for example*:** this introduces an example of the preceding statement. Use `(h / have-example-91 :ARG1 (i / implicit-predicate) :ARG2 main-event)` as the root.
- **Event nouns that classify a noun:** an event noun classifying a noun (*a photo of a handshake*, the *X 的 photo* type) is `:mod`, not `:topic`.
- **Country with 的 on what it has or does:** X 的 N, where N is something the country owns or produces (policy, army), is `:possessor`. Restrict the `:place` rule to place names modifying a noun directly, without 的. A field noun before the head (外交政策) is `:topic`.
- **Agent nouns from a trait word:** an agent noun built from a character-trait word (好事者 type) is `state`, not `habitual`.
- **Legislature named as a location:** a named legislature used as the location of something is a `building` + `:name`. The group inside it is `:place` building. A locative noun (墙上) is linked with `:place-of` to the group, not `:possessor`.
- **Words inside a compound:** an inner verb of a decomposed V+人 compound gets a modal triple but no temporal parent.

### What to keep (these scored well)

- Publication headlines as `publication` + `:name`, with quote marks as `:op`s and `:quant`/`:unit` from the classifier.
- The appositive `identity-91` for an article noun followed by its headline.
- The `:part-of` rule linking an article to its publication.
- The 能力 + V → `identity-91` rule, with V `habitual` and author neutral-affirmative.
- The V+人 / 者 decomposition.
- `:refer-person` / `:refer-number` on pronouns, and treating a pronoun for a publication as a new node with `:same-entity` to the publication.
- `but-91` for 虽然…但.
- Named occasions as `event` + `:name`.

Abstract-predicate core arguments, the refer attributes and the other attributes all scored 100.
reflect（说明和提出的修改）
**Summary of changes.** The edits fix the critique's recurring, generalizable errors. To stay under the 30000-character limit, I compressed some verbose passages, with no change of meaning:
- the `identity-91`-root temporal block;
- the abstract-predicate paragraph;
- the aspectual-relative rule;
- the Heads rule;
- the stative-verb rule;
- the concept-name examples.

**Added or fixed:**
- **Demonstrative + noun tokens** (该/此/本/这 + noun) are split into the noun with the demonstrative as `:mod`.
- **Role nouns with only a possessor** (其X, *its X*) stay the noun itself plus `:possessor`; they are no longer reified.
- **Publishing/posting verbs:** role numbers are copied from the frame (often `:ARG1` = place/medium, `:ARG2` = the thing published).
- **Sense choice:** saying verbs take the claim sense, and "serve as" takes the position-holder sense.
- **Whole-token lookup:** V+complement tokens (V出, V到, V上, V成) are looked up as a whole first.
- **Clause-linking reason/purpose nodes** get no `:aspect` and no modal triple. A fronted 为/为了 purpose clause re-enters the shared subject.
- **Temporal:**
  - later conjuncts of a coordination chain to the conjunct just before;
  - for a `but-91`/`contrast-91` root, `:ARG1` is the anchor;
  - a date that appears only inside reported content gets no triple;
  - a 靠/凭 means event `:overlap`s the event it enables;
  - 时 after a named occasion gets no node.
- **`identity-91` under 能力/机会** gets `:aspect state`.
- **Stance verbs** (support, oppose) are `state`.
- **Coreference:** generic kind nouns get no `:same-entity` link.

**Not changed:** I left the uncertain modal-parent pattern for reporting organizations alone, as the critique advised checking more gold documents first.

最终 instruction v10 全文
# Skill: the UMR of a whole document

You annotate a whole document in Uniform Meaning Representation (UMR): every sentence's sentence-level
graph, then all the document-level relations (temporal, modal, coreference) of the document. The document
is under **Input** at the end, one sentence per line.



## Guidelines

# UMR guidelines, abridged



## 1. What a UMR is





**Variables.** Every node of sentence N has a variable starting with `s` + N (`s3d`, `s3p`, `s3d2`), all
different within the document. A node that fills two roles is written once and then referred to by its
variable (re-entrancy).

## 2. Concepts

### 2.1 Events

An event is a process or a state that is **predicated**, or a process used to **refer or modify**:

- verbs used as predicates (`deny-01`, Chinese `拥有-01`);
- event nominals with process meaning (*the meeting*, *the attack*, 会议, 比赛) — annotate them as events, with their PropBank sense (活动-01);
- participles and relative-clause verbs (*the man who left*: `(p / person :ARG0-of (l / leave-11))`);
- predicated states: adjectives and nouns in predicate position (*he is tall*, 他很高) — through the
  abstract predicates of 2.3 when there is no lexical verb.

Not events: entity nouns, property words used as plain modifiers (*a tall man*: `:mod (t / tall)`),
auxiliaries and modal verbs (*will, can, must*; 会, 能, 可以, 应该 — they affect `:aspect` and modal
strength, they are not nodes), light verbs (*make a decision* → `decide-01`; 进行访问 → `访问-01`),
the copula (*be*, 是) — it becomes one of the abstract predicates.

**Chinese adjectives are verbs.** Look up every adjective, predicate or modifier: if CPB has it (荒唐, 荒谬, 可笑, 真实, 显著), it is `<word>-01` with `:ARG0` = the thing described, `:aspect state`, a temporal parent (`:overlap` its governing event) and `(author :full-affirmative …)`; as a modifier it is `:ARG0-of` (显著位置 → `(位置 :ARG0-of (显著-01 :aspect state))`). V+者 → `(者 :ARG0-of (V-00 :aspect state))`. Verbal modifiers too: V+N or V的N with N the result/patient (合成照片, 复制人) → `N :ARG1-of (V-01 :aspect performance/process)`; an event noun before 的 (握手的照片) → `:mod (握手-01 :aspect process)`; 全世界 → `(世界 :mod (全))`. 有能力/有资格 → `有-06`. Look up V+出/V+到 compounds (点出-01). If no CPB sense fits the meaning in context, use `-00` (注销-00 'posted'). `have-mod-91`/`:mod` only for words not in CPB (黑白, 八卦).

**Concept names.** An English event is its PropBank roleset (`deny-01`, `look-up-05`). A Chinese event is the
Chinese word as written with its Chinese PropBank sense (`拥有-01`, `执行-01`); a Chinese predicate that is not
in PropBank is `<word>-00` — look the verb up first; many verbs that look rare have a sense (停刊-01). Keep compound verbs whole (称为 → `称为-01`, not `称-01`). Entities and modifiers are the word itself, lemmatized in English (`doctor`, `health`) and as
written in Chinese (`宇航员`, `航天器`). Use English only for the abstract concepts below and for entity
types (`person`, `thing`, `country`, `city`, `organization`, ...).

### 2.2 Named entities

`(c / country :wiki "Russia" :name (n / name :op1 "Russia"))`: an entity-type concept, an optional `:wiki`
(the Wikipedia title, or `-` when there is none), and `:name` with one `:opN` per word of the name.
Chinese names are split into words, not characters: 欧洲议会 → `:op1 "欧洲" :op2 "议会"`. A middle dot in a transliterated name is its own `:opN` (格内洛索·波普 → `:op1 "格内洛索" :op2 "·" :op3 "波普"`).
In Chinese names keep the title brackets 《 》 as their own `:opN` (《世界新闻周报》 → `:op1 "《" :op2 "世界" ... :opN "》"`). Do not add `:wiki` in Chinese documents. A 「 」 headline right after 一篇/篇 or an article noun (新闻, 文章, 标题) is `(publication :name (name :op1 "「" … :opN "」"))`, one `:opN` per word, punctuation included, with `:quant 1 :unit (篇)` after 一篇; no inner events, no `:quote`, no modal or temporal triples; after a common noun: `(新闻 :ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 (publication …) :aspect state))`. A 「…」 that is the direct object of a reporting verb (报导, 说, 称, 指) with no such noun is reported content: a full clause (events, arguments, temporal and modal triples). After 报导, `:quote` goes on the 报导 node itself (pointing to itself), none on the content events; after 指/宣称/说, each content event gets `:quote <report>`. A named event with a year (2000年总统大选) is `(event :name (name :op1 "2000" :op2 "年" :op3 "总统大选"))`, not a date-entity; a following 时 adds no node. A named institution is one name (美国参议院 → `(building :name (name :op1 "美国" :op2 "参议院"))`). A country or place name that modifies a noun (美国小报) is `:place`, not `:mod`. Do not corefer a repeated country name that is only such a modifier. In Chinese documents a named human is `individual-person`, not `person` (`(individual-person :name (name :op1 "格内洛索" :op2 "·" :op3 "波普"))`); keep `person` for pronouns and unnamed people.

Dates: `(d / date-entity :year 1998 :month 4 :day 3)`, also `:weekday`, `:season`, `:dayperiod`, `:era`,
`:decade`, `:century`. Durations and amounts: `(t / temporal-quantity :quant 3 :unit (y / year))`,
`(m / monetary-quantity :quant 500 :unit (d / dollar))`. Ordinals: `(o / ordinal-entity :value 2)`.
Numbers are written as digits. In Chinese, a real measure word is a unit (三杯水 → `水 :quant 3 :unit 杯`);
a classifier is kept as the unit too, including 个, 份, 款, 本 (一份小报 → `小报 :quant 1 :unit (份)`).
A V+量 compound (发行量, 产量, 销量) is `(量 :quant-of (V-01 :ARG1 <whose>))`; the inner V-01 gets **no** `:aspect` and **no** modal triple; it only gets the temporal triple `(<governing verb> :overlap V)`. The amount it reaches is `量 :ARG1-of (have-quant-91 :ARG2 <number> :unit (<classifier>))`, not a separate `:ARG` of 达到/跌 and not `thing :quant`. A decade (1980年代) is `date-entity :era 1980`.

### 2.3 Abstract predicates (non-verbal clauses)

| construction | concept | roles |
|---|---|---|
| X is Y (identity, equation) | `identity-91` | `:ARG1` X, `:ARG2` Y |
| X is Adj / X has property | `have-mod-91` | `:ARG1` theme, `:ARG2` property |
| X is in/at place | `have-place-91` | `:ARG1` theme, `:ARG2` place |
| X has Y (possession) | `have-91` | `:ARG1` possessor, `:ARG2` possessum |
| Y belongs to X | `belong-91` | `:ARG1` possessum, `:ARG2` possessor |
| there is X (in L) | `exist-91` | `:ARG1` location, `:ARG2` theme |
| X is a member of category Y | `have-role-91` | `:ARG1` X, `:ARG3` category |
| X holds title T in organization O | `have-org-role-92` | `:ARG1` X, `:ARG2` O, `:ARG3` T |
| X is the R (kin, friend) of Z | `have-rel-role-92` | `:ARG1` X, `:ARG2` Z, `:ARG3` R |
| X has quantity Q | `have-quant-91` | `:ARG1` X, `:ARG2` Q |
| cause, reason | `have-cause-91` / `:cause` | |

Role nouns are reified the same way: *the president of Russia* →
`(p / person :ARG1-of (h / have-org-role-92 :ARG2 (c / country ...) :ARG3 (p2 / president)))`;
*his wife* → `(p / person :ARG1-of (h / have-rel-role-92 :ARG2 p2 :ARG3 (w / wife)))`.

When the text has a lexical verb that is in Chinese PropBank (属, 拥有), use that verb with its frame's roles instead of `belong-91` / `have-91`. Superlatives and comparatives (最, 更, *most, more*) use `(have-degree-91 :ARG1 X :ARG2 <property> :ARG3 (最))`, not `:degree`. `have-degree-91` gets no `:aspect`. A root `identity-91` / `have-*-91` (the sentence's main predicate) takes `:aspect state`; an `identity-91` inside a noun phrase (程序 :ARG0-of identity-91 查证) takes none; but one that equates a noun with a title or content (新闻 + 「…」; 能力 + V → `(能力 :ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 V))`, not `:topic`) takes `:aspect state` and `(author :full-affirmative …)`, no temporal parent. A frame such as 历史上 / 在…上 is `:temporal (上 :op1 (历史))` on the noun, not an `:ARG4` of `have-degree-91`.

### 2.4 Pronouns and implicit participants

A pronoun is `person` or `thing` with person and number: 他 / *he* → `(p / person :refer-person 3rd
:refer-number singular)`; 我们 / *we* → `:refer-person 1st :refer-number plural`; 它 / *it* → `thing` with
3rd singular. A plural noun gets `:refer-number plural`. A Chinese zero subject or object that is clearly
recoverable may be added as such a node (aligned to no word) and linked by coreference. A 他们/它/其 standing for an organization or publication named in the same sentence is no new node: reuse its variable; a possessive 他们的 before an event noun adds no `:ARG0`. In a later sentence the pronoun is its own node, coreferred to the named entity, not to an earlier pronoun.

### 2.5 Discourse relations (combining clauses)

- coordination: `(a / and :op1 ... :op2 ...)`, `or`;
- contrast: `(c / contrast-91 :ARG1 ... :ARG2 ...)`; *but* (但是, 却, 然而, 不过, 可是) `but-91` when it links two clauses of the same sentence; a sentence-initial 不过/但是 that links to the previous sentence is not annotated (the root is the clause's verb);
- concession `:concession`, condition `:condition`, cause `:cause` (或 `have-cause-91`), purpose `:purpose`,
  manner `:manner`, temporal sequence `:temporal (b / before :op1 ...)` / `after` / `consecutive`;
- *if* (如果, 只要) → `:condition` on the main event; *because* (因为, 由于) and 以…而 → `:reason`; *in order to* (为了)
  → `:purpose`; *although* (虽然, 尽管) with no second connective → `:concession`; 虽然 X，不过/但是 Y → `(but-91 :ARG1 X :ARG2 Y)`. 后来/然后 linking two clauses → `(consecutive :op1 X :op2 Y)`, no node for 后来. 以 X 为目的 → `(identity-91 :ARG1 (目的 :purpose-of <event>) :ARG2 X)` (X a plain concept), not have-purpose-91. A parenthetical 'N：quote' → `(identity-91 :ARG1 N :ARG2 <content>)`, joined to its clause by `and`; a quoted slogan's identity-91 takes `:aspect state` and its inner event `:quote` that identity-91.
- When whole clauses are linked by paired connectives (因为 X，于是/所以 Z; 为 Y，于是 …), use abstract predicates as the root: `have-reason-91` (`:ARG1` result, `:ARG2` reason) and `have-purpose-91` (`:ARG1` main event, `:ARG2` purpose), nested when both occur: `(have-reason-91 :ARG1 (have-purpose-91 :ARG1 创立 :ARG2 运用) :ARG2 改为)`. Each takes `:aspect state`, no temporal parent, and `(author :full-affirmative …)`. 以…而 inside a clause stays `:reason`.

### 2.6 Multi-word expressions

An idiom, a phrasal verb or a fixed expression is one concept (`look-up-05`, `give-up-07`; a Chinese chengyu
is one concept). A discontinuous word (帮……忙) is one concept aligned to its span. A fixed four-character idiom is one concept. A pair of coordinated nouns written together (奇闻轶事) is split: `(and :op1 (奇闻) :op2 (轶事))`.

## 3. Relations

**Participant roles** (Stage 1): the numbered roles of the predicate's roleset, `:ARG0` (agent, causer,
experiencer as initiator), `:ARG1` (patient, theme), `:ARG2`–`:ARG5` as the roleset defines them. Use the
inverse `:ARGn-of` for a relative clause or a participant nominal: 卖菜的人 → `(p / person :ARG0-of (m /
卖-01 :ARG1 (c / 菜)))`.

**Non-participant roles** (closed list, the frequent ones): `:mod` (property, demonstrative, typifying
modifier), `:possessor`, `:part` / `:part-of`, `:topic`, `:temporal` (time expression or event),
`:place`, `:direction`, `:path`, `:goal`, `:source`, `:start`, `:manner`, `:instrument`, `:cause`,
`:reason`, `:purpose`, `:condition`, `:concession`, `:duration`, `:frequency`, `:extent`, `:degree`,
`:quant`, `:unit`, `:ord`, `:range`, `:age`, `:medium`, `:companion`, `:beneficiary`, `:example`,
`:subset-of`, `:name`, `:wiki`, `:opN`, `:vocative`, `:polite`, `:other-role` (when none fits).

- Chinese adverbs are concepts, not only aspect cues. 已经, 都 and 其中 → `:mod (<word>)`; 也 whenever it is the clause's only adverb (also after a 为了 clause); no node for 甚至, 还, 就, 仍 beside 继续, or 都 in 都以…为目的; 靠 X V → `V :reason X`, no 靠 node; 曾经 → `:temporal (曾经)`. A medium (电视, 网络) is `:medium`.
- A modifier shared by coordinated nouns goes on each conjunct by reentrancy, never on the `and` node.
- Do not add arguments (agents, possessors, organizations) that the text does not express. Never re-use a participant from elsewhere in the sentence as an unexpressed agent or possessor: every re-entrancy needs a pronoun or an overt word. Exception: the overt subject of a control or aspectual verb (继续, 停止, 开始, 想, 打算) is also `:ARG0` of the embedded event or nominal (它停止了它的发行 → 发行 `:ARG0` 它). 旗下 is `:mod (旗下)`, not a possessor. Do not fill the subject of a later clause with an entity from an earlier clause (…，不过仍继续发行网络版: 发行 has no `:ARG0`).
- An edition, version or part of a publication or organization (纸本, 网络版, 分部), or its content or article (内容, 一篇新闻), takes `:part-of` its whole, not `:possessor` — but only when the whole is written with it (《…》的纸本). A bare 网络版 gets no `:part-of`.
- For an intransitive Chinese verb such as 停刊-01 (or a `-00` verb not in PropBank), the sole participant is `:ARG0`.
- When an event noun names what the head noun is (查证程序: the procedure is the verification), use `(程序 :ARG0-of (identity-91 :ARG1 (查证-01)))`, not `:mod`.
- In 'X 是 … Y，以 … 而 V' the second predicate modifies Y: `Y :ARG1-of (V :reason ...)`. Do not add a coordinating `and`.
- Apposition `<common noun> + 《name》` (八卦小报《国家询问报》): the named entity is the head, and the common noun hangs from it by `:ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 (<noun> :mod …))`. Likewise a role noun before an organization name (母公司美国媒体公司): `company` with the name `:ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 (公司 :mod (母)))`.
- In V 了 Adj-N 的《Name》 the object is the head noun with `:part-of` the named entity (创立了黑白版面的《…》 → `创立 :ARG1 (版面 :mod (黑白) :part-of (newspaper …))`); a relative clause before it (容纳…的) modifies that noun.
- 由 X 改为/变为 Y: X is `:ARG1`, Y is `:ARG2`; no `:source`. In `<Whole> 由 X 改为 Y`, when X and Y are parts or features of the subject (版面, 颜色, 名称), 改为 has **no** `:ARG0`: the subject is `:part-of` on X (`改为 :ARG1 (版面 :part-of <newspaper> :mod (黑白)) :ARG2 (版面 :mod (彩色))`).
- Build a repeated entity in full (name, apposition, modifiers) at its first mention in the graph (first in reading order), and refer to it at later exact repeats in the same sentence by its bare variable (`:possessor s7n`). A shortened repeat (周报 after 《世界新闻周报》) is its own node `(周报)` with an in-sentence `:same-entity` triple. A sentence-initial date shared by both clauses of 不过/但 is `:temporal` of both main events.
- A role noun built from a verb (创始人) is `(person :ARG1-of (have-org-role-91 :ARG3 (人 :ARG0-of (创始-00 :aspect performance))))`, with no `:ARG2` unless the organization is written with it.
- Take the sense and role numbers of every Chinese predicate from its CPB roleset, never from English (当-02 position holder; 当选 `:ARG0` electee; 刊登, 贴到, 登: `:ARG1` location, `:ARG2` thing published, no `:place`): for change-of-state and amount verbs (成-01, 达到-01, 跌-01, 增至) the theme is `:ARG0` (成-01 `:ARG0` theme, `:ARG1` result). Look it up.
- An adjective saying how an event noun's action is done is `:manner` (黑白印刷 → `印刷 :manner (黑白)`).
- '<noun> 有 A、B…等' and 如 A、B 等 → `<noun> :example (and :op1 A :op2 B :op3 (等))`; 有 is no event; 等 is always the last `:opN`. Nouns in such lists are entities (时间旅行 → `(旅行 :mod (时间))`). 重复/经常 → `:frequency`; 在 N 中 → `(中 :op1 N)` (出现 `:ARG1`); 大部分 → `:mod`.
- X 与 Y 有关系 → `(有-03 :ARG0 (and :op1 X :op2 Y) :ARG1 (关系 …))`, no `:companion`. 被指 → `指-02`. Look up the whole compound first (称为-01; 算是-01: `:ARG0` thing described, `:ARG1` what it counts as). 其中最 + Adj with no head noun → `implicit-argument :ARG1-of (have-degree-91 :ARG1 (Adj) :ARG2 (最) :ARG5 (其中))`, classifier (宗) as `:unit`.
- A common noun directly before a name (外星人 P'Lod) in running text is no apposition: `(外星人 :name (name …))`, no identity-91; in a 如 A、B 等 list each character is `individual-person` named with all its written words, descriptor included, and is not coreferred with the narrative mention. 母公司 → `(公司 :mod (母))`. 前 → `:mod (前)` on the role noun; 第一夫人 → `have-rel-role-91 :ARG3 (第一夫人 :place (country …))`.
- A demonstrative + abbreviated noun keeps the word as its concept (该刊 → `(刊 :mod (该))`, not `newspaper`).

Reported speech and thought: the reported event is the `:ARG1` of the reporting verb, as in AMR. Every
event of reported or claimed content (宣称, 指, 报导「…」, a slogan) carries `:quote <reporting event>`. 如 + an example clause → root `(have-example-91 :ARG1 (implicit-predicate) :ARG2 <main event>)`. An institution name before a locative noun is `:place` (墙上 :place-of (记者团 :place (building …))); 外交政策 → `政策 :topic (外交)`.

## 4. Attributes

### 4.1 Aspect (`:aspect`, on every event)

Use the coarse values:

| value | use for |
|---|---|
| `state` | states: non-verbal predicates (2.3), *be, have, know, want, like, believe*, 是, 有, 在, 知道, 喜欢, 认为 |
| `habitual` | an event that happens usually or repeatedly (*he walks to work*, 经常, 每天) |
| `activity` | an ongoing process with no evidence of an end (*is running*, 正在, 着; a present-tense process; most generic statements of what is done) |
| `endeavor` | a process that ended without reaching its result (*worked on it for a week*, stop doing) |
| `performance` | a process that ended and reached its result: completed past events (*denied*, *was arrested*, 了, 过) |
| `process` | an event nominal, or a process whose type cannot be told (*the meeting*, 探索 as a noun) |

Aspect cues: a publication's or institution's own recurring verbs (发行, 报导, 综合, 印刷) used as predicates are `habitual`, even with 了, unless one occasion or article is given (time clause, 一篇, one headline → `performance`); this cue does not extend to other verbs. A relative clause describing what a newly founded thing was designed to do (容纳…文章的版面) is `process`. A purpose event (为/为了 X, `have-purpose-91 :ARG2`, `:purpose`) is `activity`, not `performance`, even when it is modally full-affirmative (except the clause-initial 为了 have-reason-91 case of 2.5). 已经 + 停止 or another end verb is `state` only inside a relative clause that describes an entity (已经停止发行的小报); as the main predicate, 已经 + an end verb (已经停刊) is `performance`. Passive naming (被称为) and a past claim (宣称) are `performance`. Possession and other stative verbs (拥有, 有, 属, 是) stay `state` even with 过, 了 or 曾经, and even when limited by 短暂. An event nominal that is the object of 停止/开始 (它的发行) is `process` (no habitual). 生存, 存在 → `state`; an ongoing activity noun (活动) → `activity`. A negated event (未, 没) never gets `performance`; use `process` when its type cannot be told.



### 4.2 Polarity, mode, degree, quantity

- Negation: `:polarity -` on the negated concept (没, 不, 未, *not, never*); the event's modal strength is
  then negative (5.2). Exception: 未经 X / 没有经过 X → `经-01` with no `:polarity`; the negation is only the modal triple `(author :full-negative 经)`.
- `:degree` for intensifiers and downtoners (*very, too, most*; 很, 非常, 太, 最) as a concept:
  `:degree (v / very)`.
- `:quant` for numbers and quantifiers (`:quant 3`, `:quant (a / all)`).

## 5. Document level

The document-level annotation of sentence N is one graph `(sNs0 / sentence ...)` with up to three lists of
`(parent :relation child)` triples. The triples of sentence N have at least one node of sentence N; the
other end can be a node of an earlier sentence or a constant.

### 5.1 Temporal (`:temporal`)

A dependency structure: each event and each time expression gets **one reference time** as its parent, and
the relation says where the **child** is relative to the **parent**:

- `:before` (child before parent), `:after` (child after parent), `:overlap` (child and parent overlap),
  `:contained` (child inside parent), `:contains`, `:depends-on` (between time nodes).
- Constants: `document-creation-time`, `past-reference`, `present-reference`, `future-reference`, `root`.
- Time expressions first: a past absolute date (*1998*, 1980年代) is `(document-creation-time :before <date>)` (never `root :depends-on`); a relative one (*today, yesterday*,
  今天) depends on `document-creation-time` — `(document-creation-time :depends-on s1t)`; a vague one
  (*nowadays*) on `past-reference` / `present-reference` / `future-reference` (for 目前/现在 see the rule below). A named event + 时 (2000年总统大选时) and a date inside reported content get **no** temporal parent: the main event goes to `document-creation-time`, the content event hangs from the report (`(指 :before 当选)` when earlier).
- Then every event: (1) a time expression of its clause, if there is one (`(s1t :overlap s1e)`, not `:contained`); else
  (2) an event before it that is a clear reference time (`(s2c :before s3a)`); else (3)
  `document-creation-time` (`(document-creation-time :before s3d)` for a past event, `:overlap` for a
  present state, `:after` for a future event). Chinese has no tense: decide past, present or future from
  context, 了, 过, 将, 会.
- An event in a complement clause takes its matrix event as parent. A purpose event is `:overlap` its main event (`(创立 :overlap 运用)`). A 因为/由于 reason comes before its result: `(<reason> :before <result>)` (因为 X，于是 Z → `(X :before Z)`); 靠 X V → `(V :overlap X)`. A 时 / 在…时 clause event is the child: `(<main> :overlap <时-event>)`. In `and`-coordination the time phrase stays on the first conjunct only, and each `:opN` hangs from `:opN-1` with `:overlap`. Under `but-91`/`contrast-91`, anchor the `:ARG1` clause's event and hang the `:ARG2` event from it with `:overlap`. A resultative participle (遗留下来) comes before the event that uses it (`(运用 :before 遗留)`).
- A sentence with no time expression that continues the previous sentence's episode hangs its main event from that sentence's main event (`(s7x :overlap s8x)`); but a sentence that judges or sums up the earlier text (算是, 其中最…) is `(document-creation-time :before X)` in a past narrative.
- Reported content (宣称, 指, 说): its first event is `(<report> :overlap X)`; other content events and later clauses hang from X, not from the report. 后来 Y after X → `(X :after Y)`. A clause with 仍/继续 contrasting with a past event → `:overlap`, never `:after`.
- Anchor only the **main event** of a sentence to `document-creation-time` (or to a time expression of its clause). Attach every other event of the sentence to that main event or to a nearby event, usually `:overlap` (`:contained` if it lies inside it, `:before`/`:after` when the order is clear). Events inside relative clauses, modifiers and event nominals also need a parent, normally their governing event with `:overlap`. Leave no event without a temporal parent.
- Copular abstract predicates (`identity-91`, `have-mod-91`, `have-*-91`) normally get **no** temporal parent.
- A relative time word such as 目前 or 现在 is a `:temporal` node in the graph but gets **no** temporal parent of its own. Link the main event of its clause to `document-creation-time` with `:depends-on` (`(document-creation-time :depends-on <main event>)`), then chain the other events from that main event with `:overlap`.
- 曾经 and 已经 are graph nodes only: they get no temporal parent and no event hangs from them. A past event marked with 曾经 or 过 is `(document-creation-time :before <event>)`; chain the sentence's other events from it with `:overlap`.
- The main event of a naming or reputation clause (被称为, 被誉为) is `(document-creation-time :depends-on <event>)`, as with 目前.
- When the root is an abstract predicate (`identity-91`, `have-mod-91`), anchor to `document-creation-time` the first event inside it (usually a relative-clause event such as 发行) and hang every other event from that event: an end verb (停止) `:overlap`; a reputation or state holding within it (闻名) `:contained`; a co-occurring activity (报导) `:overlap`. Never anchor more than one event of a sentence to `document-creation-time`.
- An event that modifies a noun hangs from the event whose argument that noun is (查证 inside 程序, the argument of 经 → `(经 :overlap 查证)`), not from the sentence's first event.

### 5.2 Modal (`:modal`)

A dependency structure of conceivers and events: `(conceiver :strength event)`, starting with
`(root :modal author)` in every sentence that has events.

- Strength = the conceiver's certainty that the event happens or holds: `full-affirmative` (plain
  assertion, *will*), `partial-affirmative` (*probably, must, should*, 应该, 可能性大, 一定 as inference),
  `neutral-affirmative` (*may, might, perhaps, can*, 可能, 也许, 或许, desire/hope), `neutral-negative`,
  `partial-negative`, `full-negative` (negated: *not, never, deny*, 没, 不), `unspecified`.
- Every event the author asserts: `(author :full-affirmative s1e)`.
- 可/能/可以 before a predicate (可算是) make it `neutral-affirmative` from the author.
- The root abstract predicate (`identity-91`, `have-mod-91`, ...) of an asserted sentence also gets `(author :full-affirmative …)`, although it gets no temporal parent.
- Reported speech or thought: `(author :full-affirmative <speaker>)`, and `(<speaker> :full-affirmative <event>)` for every reporting event the speaker performs in the sentence (报导, 注销, 指). Content events of 报导/指 get `(author :full-affirmative X)` only; the top content node of a claim (宣称) gets both author and speaker triples. The conceiver is the speaker's entity node, not the reporting verb; with no written speaker (被指) use the whole subject node of the first content event (the `and` if coordinated). The top content node (with `:quote`, even an abstract predicate) gets both `author` and conceiver triples.
- Connectives (`but-91`, `and`, `consecutive`) get no modal triple.
- An event under a modal or complement-taking predicate (*want, try, plan, decide, hope*, 想, 希望, 打算,
  决定, 需要): the predicate is asserted by the author, the complement has the predicate as parent with
  `unspecified` (or the strength the predicate implies): `(author :full-affirmative s3w)`
  `(s3w :unspecified s3g)`.
- A conceiver that is not in the text is `null-conceiver`. A purpose the text presents as realized (founded to hold such articles, and it did) is `(author :full-affirmative <purpose>)`, not `unspecified` under the main event. An event nominal naming a usual procedure (一般的…程序) under a negated event is `(author :partial-affirmative <nominal>)`. Purpose and condition clauses may use the
  constants `purpose` and `have-condition` as parents of their events.
- In the sentence graph, write the strength of an event that is not `full-affirmative` from the author as
  `:modal-strength <value>` too (the scorers move it to the document level).

### 5.3 Coreference (`:coref`)

- `(earlier :same-entity later)`: two mentions of the same entity — a pronoun and its antecedent, a repeated
  name, a definite description. Link each mention to its closest earlier mention, earlier one first;
  link entity nodes, never `name` nodes.
- `(earlier :same-event later)`: two mentions of the same event.
- `(a :subset-of b)`: the entity or event a is a subset or part of b.
- Within one sentence, coreference is a re-entrancy (one variable), except a shortened name repeat (see 3).
- Link two mentions only when they pick out the same individual or the same single event. Do not link two mentions of the same verb with different arguments, times or polarity (发行 of the print edition vs 发行 of the online edition). Do not link noun phrases with the same head but different restrictors (许多内容 vs 荒诞不经的内容). Never put a `:subset-of` triple inside one sentence or from a 其中 phrase. Do not link events expressed by different verbs (创刊 vs 创立) unless the text makes them clearly identical. When in doubt, leave the link out; chains like 周报 / 该周报 / 《…周报》 are what gold annotates.

## 6. Alignment

Every node of a sentence graph is aligned to the words that express it: `s1x: 4-4` (1-based word positions,
first and last, both included). A node with no word in the sentence (`person` for a zero pronoun, `and`
without a conjunction, `have-mod-91` without a copula, a `name` node) is `0-0`. A named entity's type
node is aligned to the name's words.



## Examples

- Temporal chain (5.1): 目前…停刊，不过仍继续发行网络版 → `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4x 停刊) (s4x :overlap s4x2 继续) (s4x2 :overlap s4x6 发行)`; 目前 has no temporal parent.
- Copular root (5.1): 是…已经停止发行的小报，以报导…而闻名 → `(document-creation-time :before 发行) (发行 :overlap 停止) (闻名 :contained 发行) (发行 :overlap 报导)`; modal `(author :full-affirmative identity-91)`.



- Negation (4.2): 都未经一般的新闻查证程序 → `(经-01 :mod (都) :aspect process)` without `:polarity`; modal `(author :full-negative 经) (author :partial-affirmative 查证)`.










- Roles (3): 黑白印刷也成了该刊的特色 → `(成-01 :ARG0 (印刷-01 :manner (黑白) :aspect habitual) :ARG1 (特色 :poss… (刊 :mod (该))))`; temporal from previous sentence's main event.






- Quote (5.2): 宣称其报导都是真实的 → `(have-mod-91 :quote s12x …)`, `(author :full-affirmative have-mod-91) (s12n :full-affirmative have-mod-91)`, likewise each content 报导; slogan → `(identity-91 :aspect state)`.



- Pronoun (2.4): 他们的报导…他们的标语 → `(报导-01 :aspect habitual)`, `(标语 :possessor s12n)`; next sentence 他们 → `(s12n :same-entity s13p)`.
- 算是 (3): 其中最大宗可算是…活动 → `(算是-01 :ARG0 (implicit-argument :ARG1-of (have-degree-91 :ARG1 (大) :ARG2 (最) :ARG5 (其中)) :unit (宗)) :ARG1 (活动-01 …))`, `(author :neutral-affirmative 算是) (document-creation-time :before 算是)`.

- Title (2.2): 刊登一篇「苏联复制…」 → `(刊登-01 :ARG2 (publication :name (name :op1 "「" :op2 "苏联" … "」") :quant 1 :unit (篇)))`, no events inside.
- Adjective (2.1): 内容虽然荒唐 → `(荒唐-01 :ARG0 (内容 :part-of 周报) :aspect state)`.
- Report (5.1, 5.2): 指柯林顿1992年靠外星人背书当选 → `(当选-01 :ARG0 柯林顿 :reason (背书-00 :ARG0 外星人))`, `(指 :before 当选)`, `(刊 :full-affirmative 指) (author :full-affirmative 当选)`.

- 报导「…」 (2.2, 3): 报导「外星人支持布什当总统」 → `(报导-01 :quote <itself> :ARG1 (支持-01 :ARG0 (外星人) :ARG1 (当-02 :ARG0 布什 :ARG1 (总统))))`; 当 no aspect/modal; a later 外星人 is a new node.
- 为了 (2.5): 为了讽刺…，他们也…报导 → `(have-reason-91 :ARG1 (报导-01 :mod (也)) :ARG2 (讽刺-01 :ARG0 他们 :aspect performance))`; 有能力点出 → `点出 :ARG0 编辑`.
- V+N (2.1): 合成照片 → `(注销 :overlap 合成)`; 复制人 → `复制-01 :aspect process`, no temporal parent; have-example-91 bare.

critique
# Review of the annotator's UMR of the *Weekly World News* document, with changes to the instruction

The biggest losses were in temporal relations (F 30), reentrancy (F 15), aspect (F 60), event core and peripheral roles, and named-entity tokens and wiki. Most of these come from a handful of rules that the instruction leaves out or gets wrong for Chinese. The problems are listed below, most costly first.

---

## 1. Temporal structure: the annotator anchors everything to DCT or to a time word, not to other events (h_temporal F 30, about 12 units)

**What went wrong:**
- **Sentence 1:** every event hung from `document-creation-time` (DCT), and 停止 was used as the parent of 发行.
  - Gold anchors only the main habitual event to DCT and hangs the rest from it: `(document-creation-time :before s1x3) (s1x3 :overlap s1x4) (s1x7 :contained s1x3) (s1x3 :overlap s1x8)`.
  - Gold gives no temporal parent to `identity-91`. The annotator's `(document-creation-time :overlap s1i)` was counted as extra.
- **Sentence 4:** the annotator wrote `(present-reference :depends-on s4m) (s4m :contained s4t) (s4m :contained s4j)`. Gold does not anchor the events to 目前. It chains them: `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4x) (s4x :overlap s4x2) (s4x2 :overlap s4x6)`.
- **Sentence 5:** gold has `(document-creation-time :depends-on s5x)`; the annotator wrote `:overlap`.
- **Missing parents:** two events got no temporal parent at all:
  - 查证 in sentence 2: gold `(s2x8 :overlap s2x13)`.
  - 属 in sentence 3: gold `(s3x :overlap s3x6)`.

**Why:** Rule 5.1 says "Annotate event–event relations only when they are clear" and makes DCT the default. That pushes the annotator to anchor every clause to DCT. Nothing tells it that:
- the other events of a sentence normally chain off the first one, usually with `:overlap`;
- events inside nouns and relative clauses also need a parent;
- non-verbal `identity-91` and abstract predicates may get no temporal parent;
- the release data uses `document-creation-time :depends-on <event>` for the main event of some sentences.

**Change:**
- Replace the "only when they are clear" line with: "Anchor one main event of each sentence to DCT (or to a time expression). Attach every other event of the sentence to that event or to a nearby event, usually with `:overlap` (`:contained` if it lies inside it). Every event inside a relative clause or modifier also gets a parent, normally its governing event with `:overlap`."
- Add: "Do not give `identity-91` or `have-*-91` copular predicates a temporal parent."
- Add: "A time word like 目前 or 现在 is a modifier. Do not make it the parent of the events."
- Add the sentence 4 chain from gold as an example.

## 2. Measure words, aspect markers and adverbs dropped as nodes (a_entity_found, d_peripheral, c_other_attributes: about 12 units)

**What went wrong:**
- **Classifier plus measure word:**
  - 一份…小报: gold has `:quant 1 :unit (s1x5 / 份)`. The annotator dropped both.
  - 一个…节目: gold has `:quant 1 :unit (s3x7 / 个)`. The annotator dropped the unit.

  The instruction says 个 "is dropped", which is wrong for this data. Another gold document confirms it: 一款 → `:quant 1 :unit (款)`.
- **Adverbs gold keeps as `:mod` nodes, which the annotator left out:**
  - 已经 in sentence 1 (`:mod (s1x6 / 已经)` on 停止) and in sentence 4;
  - 都 in sentence 2;
  - 其中 in sentence 2;
  - 曾经 in sentence 3 (gold has `:temporal (s3x9 / 曾经)`).

**Why:** Section 2.2 explicitly says to drop 个/本/只/位. The instruction also never says that Chinese adverbs (已经, 都, 也, 仍, 曾经) become nodes. The annotator did keep 也 and 仍, but treated 已经 and 曾经 as pure aspect markers.

**Change:**
- Rewrite the classifier rule: "一 + classifier + noun → `:quant 1 :unit (<classifier>)`, for 个, 份, 款 and the like as well."
- Add: "Adverbs such as 已经, 都, 也, 仍, 曾经 and 其中 are concepts: `:mod (<word>)`, or `:temporal` for 曾经. They are not only aspect cues."

## 3. Named entities: brackets, wiki, and how the country modifier attaches (f_name_tokens 50, f_wiki 0, e_peripheral_labels: about 9 units)

**What went wrong:**
- **Title brackets:** the annotator wrote `:op1 "世界" :op2 "新闻" :op3 "周报"` in sentences 1 and 4. Gold includes the brackets: `:op1 "《" :op2 "世界" :op3 "新闻" :op4 "周报" :op5 "》"`. Another gold document does the same for every 《…》 title.
- **Wiki:** the annotator added `:wiki` three times (the paper twice and 美国 once in each of sentences 1 and 5 — four wiki values in all). Gold Chinese data has no `:wiki`, so each one counts as an extra.
- **Country as modifier:**
  - 美国超市小报 and 美国历史: gold uses `:place (s1c / country …)`. The annotator used `:mod`.
  - 电视节目: gold uses `:medium (电视)`. The annotator used `:mod`.
- **Unwanted coref:** 美国 in sentence 1 and 美国 in sentence 5 were linked; gold does not link them.

**Change:**
- "In Chinese names, keep the title brackets 《 》 as their own `:opN`."
- "Do not add `:wiki` in Chinese documents."
- "A country or place name that modifies a noun is `:place`, not `:mod`. A medium (电视, 网络) is `:medium`."
- "Do not corefer a repeated country name used only as a modifier."

## 4. Aspect (c_aspect F 60, 6 units)

**What went wrong:**
| word | annotator | gold | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 发行 (sentence 1) | process | habitual | |
| 停止 (sentence 1) | performance | state | 已经停止 = it is in the stopped state |
| 综合 (sentence 2) | performance | habitual | a characterizing description of the paper |
| 经 (sentence 2) | habitual | process | |
| 发行 (sentence 4) | activity | habitual | |
| 称为 (sentence 5) | state | performance | |

**Why:** The table in 4.1 ties 了 to `performance`. It does not say that verbs describing what a publication or organization regularly does (发行, 报导, 综合) are `habitual`, even with 了. It also does not say that 已经 + a stop or end verb in a relative clause that describes something is a resulting `state`.

**Change:** add to 4.1:
- "Recurring institutional activities (publishing, reporting, compiling) are `habitual`, even with 了."
- "已经 + 停止 or another end verb used to describe an entity → `state`."
- "Passive naming or labelling (被称为) → `performance`."

## 5. Clause structure and reentrancy (g_reentrancy F 15, core and peripheral roles)

**What went wrong:**
- **Sentence 1, wrong root and wrong arguments:**
  - The annotator wrapped the sentence in `and` and made 闻名 a separate clause whose ARG1 and ARG0 point to the name node.
  - Gold puts 闻名 inside the predicate noun: `小报 :ARG1-of (闻名-01 :reason (报导-01 :ARG0 s1x …))`.
  - The annotator also added `发行-01 :ARG1 s1x` and inverted the stop relation. Gold has `发行-01 :ARG1-of (停止-01)`.
- **Sentence 2, modifiers on a coordination:**
  - The annotator put shared modifiers on the `and` node and added a made-up role `:subset`.
  - Gold distributes them to each conjunct as reentrancies: `新闻 :mod s2x6 :mod s2x7`, `专栏 :mod s2x6 :mod s2x7`.
- **Sentence 4, invented arguments:** `发行-01 :ARG0 s4n` and `网络版 :possessor s4n` are not in the text. They were counted as extra reentrancies.
- **以…而闻名:** gold uses `:reason`, not `:cause`. The same holds for 由于 in sentence 5: gold `:reason`, annotator `:cause`.

**Change:**
- "In 'X 是 … Y, 以 … 而 V' the second predicate modifies Y (`Y :ARG1-of V`). Do not add a coordinating `and`."
- "Distribute a shared modifier to each conjunct by reentrancy. Never put `:mod` on `and`."
- "Do not add arguments that are not expressed or clearly implied."
- "因为, 由于 and 以…而 → `:reason`." This fixes the instruction's current mapping of 因为/由于 to `:cause`.

## 6. Lexical choices: concept splits, abstract-predicate frames, core roles (event and entity concepts, core args: about 7 units)

**What went wrong:**
- **奇闻轶事:** treated as one chengyu node. Gold splits it: `and :op1 奇闻 :op2 轶事`, because it is two nouns.
- **属 in sentence 3:** the annotator used `belong-91` with ARG2. Gold uses the PropBank verb `属-02` with `:ARG0` = 节目 and `:ARG1` = 周报. A lexical verb present in Chinese PropBank wins over the abstract predicate.
- **停刊:** gold has `:ARG0 纸本`; the annotator used ARG1. Also, 纸本 is `:part-of` the newspaper, not its `:possessor`.
- **不过:** gold uses `but-91`; the annotator used `contrast-91`. The instruction already lists *but* → `but-91` for 但是 but not for 不过. Add 不过 and 可是 to that list.
- **最富创意:** gold has `have-degree-91 :ARG2 (富-01 :ARG1 创意) :ARG3 (最)`. The annotator wrote `:degree 最` on 富. The table should add `have-degree-91` for superlatives and comparatives.
- **历史上:** gold makes 上 a node with `:op1 历史`, attached as `:temporal`.
- **未经…程序:** gold has `程序 :ARG0-of (identity-91 :ARG1 查证-01)` and no `:polarity` on 经-01 (the negation is carried only by the modal relation). Gold also makes 查证 `partial-affirmative` from the author. These are idiosyncratic. A short note would suffice: "With 未经 a negated event, the full-negative modal relation is enough."

**Change:**
- Add to 2.6: "A chengyu is one concept only if it is a fixed four-character idiom. Coordinated noun pairs such as 奇闻轶事 are split."
- Add to 2.3: "Prefer the Chinese PropBank verb (属-02, 拥有-01) over `belong-91` / `have-91` when the verb is in the text; check its roles with the frame."

## Keep (worked well)

- **Modal annotation (F 94):** `(root :modal author)` plus `full-affirmative` for asserted events, and `full-negative` for 未经. Keep 5.2 as it is.
- **Coreference chain for the paper (recall 100):** 周报 linked across sentences, earlier mention first, entity nodes only. Keep 5.3.
- **Senses and document format:** all PropBank senses were correct (100) and the document format was correct (100). Keep the `<word>-01` and `-00` rules and the format conventions.
- **identity-91 for 是:** used correctly, with ARG1 and ARG2 right (core args of abstract predicates scored 100).
- **Chinese concept wording:** concepts kept as written in Chinese, and event nominals such as 查证 marked `process`.
reflect（说明和提出的修改）
The changes target the costliest problems in the critique that will recur on other documents. I left the parts that worked (modal, coreference, senses, format) unchanged.

1. **Temporal structure (largest loss).** I replaced the rule that only clear event–event relations are annotated, which made the annotator default every event to the document creation time. The new rule:
   - anchors one main event of the sentence to the document creation time or a time expression;
   - chains every other event to it or to a nearby event, usually with `:overlap`;
   - gives events in relative clauses and modifiers a parent too;
   - attaches a relative time word such as 目前 or 现在 to the document creation time with `:depends-on`, not to `present-reference`;
   - leaves copular abstract predicates without a temporal parent.
2. **Classifiers and adverbs.** The old classifier rule was wrong for this data. Now 一 + classifier + noun gives `:quant 1 :unit (classifier)`. Adverbs such as 已经, 都, 也, 仍 and 其中 become `:mod` concepts, and 曾经 becomes `:temporal`.
3. **Chinese names.** Title brackets 《 》 are kept as their own `:opN`. Chinese documents get no `:wiki`. A country name modifying a noun is `:place`, and a medium is `:medium`.
4. **Aspect.** Three cues are added:
   - recurring institutional activities are `habitual`, even with 了;
   - 已经 + an end verb used to describe an entity is `state`;
   - 被称为 is `performance`.
5. **Clause structure.**
   - 因为, 由于 and 以…而 now map to `:reason`.
   - 不过 and 可是 now map to `but-91`.
   - A shared modifier goes on each conjunct by reentrancy, never on `and`.
   - No arguments are invented.
   - In 以…而 constructions the predicate modifies the noun it describes, with no coordinating `and`.
6. **Lexical choices.**
   - A Chinese PropBank verb is preferred over `belong-91` or `have-91`.
   - Superlatives use `have-degree-91`.
   - Coordinated noun pairs written as one four-character word are split.

Each fix has a short example in a new Examples section.

critique
# Review of the annotator's UMR for the 《世界新闻周报》 document: what in the instruction to change

Most of the lost score is in **temporal** (F 50) and **coreference** (chain P 56, subset P 0). After those come a few local graph errors in sentences 4 and 5. Two of the costliest patterns come from the instruction itself: one of its examples is wrong, and one of its rules is too broad.

## 1. Temporal anchoring: the wrong main event, and a wrong example (h_temporal, about 8 units)

**What went wrong.**
- **Sentence 1** (是…已经停止发行的…小报，以报导…而闻名):
  - The root is `identity-91`, so the annotator had no verbal main event. It anchored two events to the document creation time (DCT): `(document-creation-time :overlap s1x5 停止)` and `(document-creation-time :overlap s1x7 闻名)`. It also hung 报导 from 闻名.
  - Gold anchors the first real event, 发行, and hangs everything else from it: `(document-creation-time :before s1x3 发行) (s1x3 :overlap s1x4 停止) (s1x7 闻名 :contained s1x3) (s1x3 :overlap s1x8 报导)`.
  - That is 4 units in one sentence.
- **Sentence 4** (目前…纸本已经停刊，不过仍继续发行网络版):
  - Annotation: `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4x 目前) (s4x :overlap s4x2 停刊)`.
  - Gold: `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4x 停刊) (s4x :overlap s4x2 继续) (s4x2 :overlap s4x6 发行)`. 目前 gets **no** temporal parent.
  - The instruction's own example, "目前…发行…网络版 → `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4x) (s4x :overlap s4x2)…`", was clearly copied from this gold. But it misread `s4x` as 目前; in gold it is the event 停刊. The rule in 5.1 ("a relative time word such as 目前 … attached as `(document-creation-time :depends-on <node>)`") was built on that misreading. The annotator followed it faithfully.
- **Sentence 5**: gold has `(document-creation-time :depends-on s5x 称为)`; the annotation has `:before`. This is the same pattern as sentence 4: in these sentences gold links the main event to DCT with `:depends-on`.
- **Sentence 2**: 查证 was attached to 综合. Gold attaches it to its governing event: `(s2x8 经 :overlap s2x13 查证)`. The instruction already says "normally their governing event". The annotator did not follow it here.

**Changes to the instruction.**
- **Fix the example** to: `目前…停刊…继续发行 → (document-creation-time :depends-on s4x 停刊) (s4x :overlap s4x2 继续) (s4x2 :overlap s4x6 发行)`.
- **Rewrite the 目前/现在 rule**: "A relative time word such as 目前 or 现在 is a `:temporal` node in the graph but gets no temporal parent of its own. Link the main event of its clause to `document-creation-time` with `:depends-on`, then chain the other events from that main event with `:overlap`."
- **Add a rule for copular sentences**: "When the root is an abstract predicate (`identity-91`, `have-mod-91`), anchor to DCT the first event inside it, usually a relative-clause event such as 发行. Hang every other event from that event: an end verb (停止) `:overlap`; a reputation or state that holds within it (闻名) `:contained`; a co-occurring activity (报导) `:overlap`. Do not anchor more than one event of a sentence to DCT."
- **Stress the governing-event rule**: "An event that modifies a noun hangs from the event whose argument that noun is (查证 in 程序 → 经), not from the sentence's first event."

## 2. Too many coreference and subset links (j_coref_chain 4 extra units, j_coref_subset 1 extra)

**What went wrong.**
- `(s1x4 :same-event s4x6)`: 发行 in sentence 1 is the publication that stopped; 发行 in sentence 4 is the still-continuing publication of the online edition. These are different events.
- `(s2x9 :same-entity s5x9)`: 许多内容 (much of the content, not verified) and 荒诞不经的内容 (its absurd content) are different sets.
- `(s2x9 :subset-of s2a2)`: a within-sentence `:subset-of` link, which gold does not use.

**Why.** Section 5.3 tells the annotator to link mentions but gives it no reason to hold back, so it linked repeated words.

**Change.** Add: "Link two mentions only when they pick out the same individual or the same single event. Do not link two mentions of the same verb that have different arguments, times or polarity (发行 of the print edition vs 发行 of the online edition). Do not link two noun phrases with the same head but different restrictors (许多内容 vs 荒诞不经的内容). Do not put a `:subset-of` triple inside one sentence. When in doubt, leave the link out: the newspaper chain (周报 / 该周报 / 《世界新闻周报》) is the kind of chain gold annotates."

## 3. The "已经 + end verb = state" rule was over-applied (c_aspect 1 unit; it also cost the 停刊 temporal unit)

**What went wrong.** In sentence 4, 已经停刊 is a main predicate. The annotator gave it `:aspect state`; gold has `:aspect performance`.

**Why.** The 4.1 cue was meant for sentence 1's relative clause (已经停止发行的小报), where `state` is right. The annotator applied it to a main predicate.

**Change.** Narrow the cue: "only when 已经 + 停止/停刊 sits in a relative clause that describes an entity (…的 N). As the main predicate, 已经 + an end verb is `performance`."

## 4. Roles invented or mislabelled in sentence 4 (d_core_args / e_core_labels / d_peripheral / g_reentrancy, about 6 units)

**What went wrong.**
- 纸本 of 停刊: annotation `:ARG1`; gold `:ARG0`.
- 《世界新闻周报》的纸本: annotation `:possessor`; gold `(纸本 :part-of (newspaper …))`.
- The annotator added `:ARG0 s4n` to 发行-01, but the text gives no subject. Gold has `(发行-01 :ARG1 (网络版) :aspect habitual)` only.

**Changes to the instruction.**
- Add: "An edition, version or part of a publication or organization (纸本, 网络版, 分部) takes `:part-of` its whole, not `:possessor`."
- Add: "For a `-01` sense of an intransitive verb that is not in PropBank (停刊, 停业), the sole participant is `:ARG0`."
- Repeat the existing rule with this case: "Do not fill the subject of a second clause with an entity from the first clause (…，不过仍继续发行网络版 has no `:ARG0`)."

## 5. Superlative scope and concept form in sentence 5 (a_event_concept 1, a_entity_found 1, d_core_args_abstract 1, d_peripheral 1, c_aspect 1)

**What went wrong.**
- 称为: the annotator wrote `称-01`; gold has `称为-01`. A Chinese concept should keep the verb as written.
- 美国历史上: the annotator made it `:ARG4` of `have-degree-91`. Gold has `(报纸 :temporal (上 :op1 (历史 :place (country …))))`.
- `have-degree-91` was given `:aspect state`. Gold gives it no aspect.

**Changes to the instruction.**
- Add: "Keep compound verbs whole (称为 → `称为-01`, not `称-01`)."
- Add: "A 在/…上 frame such as 历史上 is `:temporal (上 :op1 (历史))` on the noun. It is not `:ARG4` of `have-degree-91`."
- Add: "`have-degree-91` gets no `:aspect`." Gold annotations generally treat it as an abstract predicate with no aspect; this sentence is an example.

## 6. Smaller items (about 1–2 units each)

- **The `identity-91` root needs a modal triple.** Gold has `(author :full-affirmative s1i2)`. Add: "In the modal list, the root abstract predicate of an asserted sentence gets `(author :full-affirmative …)`, even though it gets no temporal parent." The temporal rule ("Copular abstract predicates … normally get **no** temporal parent") is right; keep it.
- **程序 with an event-noun modifier.** 新闻查证程序 in gold is `(程序 :ARG0-of (identity-91 :ARG1 (查证-01 …)))`, not `:mod 查证-01`. Add a line: when an event noun names what the head noun *is* (the procedure is the verification), use `identity-91`.
- **未经 in gold has no `:polarity -` and has aspect `process`, while its modal is `full-negative`.** Other gold sentences (未被录取, 并未受伤) do use `:polarity -` together with full-negative. So this one is a gold quirk. Keep the current polarity rule.

## What the instruction should keep

The annotator got these right, and the matching rules should stay as they are:

- **Named entities**: bracketed names split into words with 《 》 as their own `:opN`, no `:wiki`, `newspaper` as the type, and 美国 as `:place` on 小报. f_name_tokens scored 100.
- **Classifiers** as `:quant` + `:unit` (一份 → 份, 一个 → 个).
- **以…而闻名** as `(闻名-01 :reason 报导-01)` with no extra `and`.
- **Lexical verbs** used instead of abstract predicates: `属-02` and `拥有-01` rather than `belong-91` / `have-91`.
- **Superlatives**: `have-degree-91 :ARG3 (最)`.
- **Adverbs**: 已经, 都, 也, 仍, 其中 as `:mod`, and 曾经 as `:temporal`.
- **Shared modifiers** on coordinated nouns written by re-entrancy on each conjunct (各式各样 and 奇怪 on both 新闻 and 专栏).
- **Habitual aspect** for a publication's recurring activities (发行, 报导, 综合).
- **The newspaper coreference chain** (s1n → s2x2 → s3x2 → s4n → s5x2) and the `:medium` and `:duration` roles. Event senses scored 100.
reflect（说明和提出的修改）
The critique's largest losses were in temporal and coreference. Part of the temporal loss came from the instruction itself: it had a wrong example and a rule built on that example. These are the changes:

1. **Temporal (5.1).**
   - Rewrote the 目前/现在 rule. The time word is a graph node with no temporal parent of its own. The clause's main event is linked to document-creation-time with `:depends-on`, and the other events are chained from it with `:overlap`.
   - Removed the conflicting mention of 现在 under the vague time words.
   - Fixed the wrong example.
   - Added a rule for copular-root sentences: anchor only the first inner event, hang the others from it, and anchor at most one event to document-creation-time.
   - Strengthened the governing-event rule for events that modify nouns.
2. **Coreference (5.3).** Added restraint: link only the same individual or the same single event. Do not link the same verb with different arguments, or the same head noun with different restrictors. No `:subset-of` inside one sentence.
3. **Aspect.** Narrowed the "已经 + end verb = state" cue to relative clauses that describe an entity. As the main predicate it is `performance`.
4. **Roles.**
   - Editions and parts of a publication take `:part-of`.
   - The sole participant of an intransitive Chinese verb missing from PropBank is `:ARG0`.
   - Do not fill the subject of a later clause from an earlier clause.
   - An event noun that names what the head noun is uses `identity-91`.
5. **Concepts.**
   - Keep compound verbs whole (称为-01).
   - 历史上 is `:temporal (上 :op1 历史)`.
   - `have-degree-91` gets no aspect.
6. **Modal (5.2).** The root abstract predicate of an asserted sentence gets `(author :full-affirmative …)`.
