# Review of the UMR annotation of sentences 16–20: costly error patterns and changes to the instruction

The structural checks scored well: refer attributes 100, the coreference chain 100, document format 100, core labels 97. The cost comes from five places:
- **One misapplied title rule** in sentence 16. It is the main cause of other_attributes P 36, name tokens, granularity, event concepts and core arguments.
- **Temporal anchoring** (h_temporal F 42), where the rules contradict each other.
- **Reported-speech modal and `:quote`.** The instruction's own rule text contradicts its example here.
- **Missing aspect, modal and arguments on `identity-91`.**
- **Senses that were never looked up.**

## 1. 「…」 directly after a reporting verb was annotated as a publication title (most costly)

**Cost.** This one decision cost about 25 units:
- 7 extra `:opN` (that is why other_attributes precision is 36);
- name_tokens 1 extra;
- granularity 5;
- event_concept 2, entity_found 2, entity_concept 1;
- core args 4 missing (支持 `:ARG0/:ARG1`, 当 `:ARG0/:ARG1`);
- aspect 1;
- temporal 2 missing (支持, 当);
- modal 1 missing (支持).

**What happened.** For 该刊报导「外星人支持布什当总统」 the annotator produced `报导-01 :ARG1 (publication :name (name :op1 "「" :op2 "外星人" … :op7 "」"))`.

The gold builds the clause:
```
:ARG1 (支持-01 :ARG0 (外星人) :ARG1 (当-02 :ARG0 (individual-person :name (name :op1 "布什")) :ARG1 (总统)) :aspect state)
```
with temporal `(报导 :overlap 支持) (支持 :overlap 当)` and modal `(author :full-affirmative 支持)`.

**Why.** Rule 2.2 says "A headline or article title in 「 」 … is `publication` … no inner events". Its triggers are only examples in parentheses (一篇「…」, 新闻「…」), so the annotator applied it to every 「」. The title rule is right where a counted article noun is present: sentences 18, 19 and 20 were all correct and should stay that way.

**Change.** Make the trigger explicit: 「…」 is a `publication` only when 一篇 / 篇 or an article noun (新闻, 文章, 标题) comes right before it. When 「…」 is the direct object of a reporting verb (报导, 说, 称, 指) with no such noun, it is reported content:
- annotate it as a clause, with full events and arguments;
- its events get `:aspect`, temporal parent `(<report> :overlap X)` and modal triples;
- its top event carries `:quote <report>`.

## 2. Temporal anchoring: time phrases, 时-clauses, report content and clause chains

**Cost.** About 14 temporal units (R 41 / P 43), plus 2 extra reentrancies.

**a. Named events and dates were used as reference times.**
- The annotator wrote `(document-creation-time :before s16e)` and `(s16e :overlap 报导)` for 2000年总统大选时, and `(DCT :before 1992) (1992 :overlap 当选)`.
- Gold gives the named event and the date **no** temporal parent, and has `(document-creation-time :before 报导)` and `(指 :before 当选)`.
- The instruction's own example already says `(指 :before 当选)`, but the general "time expression first" rule overrode it.

Change: "A named event used as a time phrase (`event :name …` + 时) is not a temporal node; anchor the main event to `document-creation-time`. In reported content, the report rule wins over a date inside the content: the date gets no parent, and the content event hangs from the report (`:before` when the content is earlier, as with 1992 vs 2000)."

**b. A 时-clause event was made the parent of the main event.**
- Sentence 18 (如全世界在争论…时，它…刊登): the annotator had `(DCT :before 争论) (争论 :overlap 刊登)`.
- Gold has `(DCT :before 刊登) (刊登 :overlap 争论)`.

Change: "The event of a 时 / 当…时 clause is the child: `(<main> :overlap <时-event>)`. Only the main event goes to `document-creation-time`."

**c. A shared time phrase was copied onto every conjunct of `and`.** The annotator put `:temporal s16e` on 注销 and 指 as well (2 extra reentrancies). The 不过/但 rule was over-applied. Change: "In `and`-coordination the time phrase stays on the first conjunct only."

**d. Each conjunct hangs from the preceding one, not from the first.**
- Gold has `(报导 :overlap 注销) (注销 :overlap 指)`; the annotator had 报导 → 指.
- Change: chain `:opN` from `:opN-1`.

**e. A 靠 / reason event got `:before`.**
- 靠外星人背书当选: the annotator had `(当选 :before 背书)`; gold has `(当选 :overlap 背书)`.
- Change: in "靠 X V", X is `:reason`, but temporally `(V :overlap X)`. The rule "a reason comes before its result" applies only to 因为/由于 clauses.

**f. Modifier events got the wrong relation or no parent.**
- 握手的合成照片: gold chains `(注销 :overlap 合成) (合成 :overlap 握手)`. The annotator had `(注销 :before 握手)` and gave 合成 no node at all.
- Sentence 17: 真实 modifies 新闻, which is the argument of 荒谬, so gold has `(荒谬 :overlap 真实)`. The annotator hung it from 点出.
- The existing rule ("hangs from the event whose argument that noun is") was not followed. Repeat it in the examples with 真实新闻的荒谬.

**g. With `but-91` the first clause was not anchored.**
- Sentence 17: gold has `(DCT :before 荒唐) (荒唐 :overlap 有)`; the annotator anchored 有.
- Change: "Under `but-91` / `contrast-91`, anchor the `:ARG1` clause's event and hang the `:ARG2` event from it with `:overlap`."

## 3. Reported speech: modal conceivers and `:quote`

**Cost.** 6 modal units, plus 2 reentrancy units (`:quote`).

**What happened.**
- In sentence 16 the annotator gave 报导, 注销 and 指 the parent `author`. Gold has `(s16x4/刊 :full-affirmative 报导 / 注销 / 指)` and `(author :full-affirmative 刊)`.
- It also added `(刊 :full-affirmative 当选)` and `(刊 :full-affirmative 背书)`. Gold gives the content events `author` only.

**Why.** Rule 5.2 says the content gets "both" author and speaker triples. The instruction's own example says the opposite: `(刊 :full-affirmative 指) (author :full-affirmative 当选)`. The annotator followed the rule text. It also skipped "`(author :full-affirmative s9p)` for the speaker node", which cost the missing 刊 unit.

**Change.** Rewrite 5.2 to match the example:
- `(author :full-affirmative <speaker>)`;
- `(<speaker> :full-affirmative <reporting event>)` for every event the speaker performs in that sentence (报导, 注销, 指);
- content events get `(author :full-affirmative X)`.

For `:quote`, gold puts it on every event of the content (当选 **and** 背书 `:quote 指`). Change "the top node … must carry `:quote`" to "every event of the reported content carries `:quote <report>`".

## 4. `identity-91` inside a noun phrase got no aspect, no modal triple, or was replaced by `:topic`

**Cost.** About 8 units: aspect 2, modal 2, core_args_abstract 2, event_concept 1, peripheral 1.

**What happened.**
- In sentence 20, 新闻 `:ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 publication)` was correct but had no `:aspect`. Gold adds `:aspect state` and `(author :full-affirmative identity-91)`.
- In sentence 17 the annotator wrote 能力 `:topic` 点出. Gold has `(能力 :ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 (点出-01 …) :aspect state))`, with `(author :full-affirmative identity-91)`.

**Why.** Rule 2.3 says that an `identity-91` inside a noun phrase "takes none", and 5.1/5.2 give the root `identity-91` a modal triple only. The annotator followed this rule, so the rule itself is too broad.

**Change.**
- An `identity-91` that equates a noun with a title or a content (新闻「…」, 能力 + V) takes `:aspect state` and `(author :full-affirmative …)`. It still gets no temporal parent.
- Keep "no aspect" only for the 程序 / 查证 kind.
- Add: "能力/资格 + V → `(能力 :ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 V))`, not `:topic`."

## 5. Senses and modifier events: no PropBank lookup

**Cost.** event_sense 5, plus related aspect, modal and argument units, about 10 in total.

**What happened.**
- 点出: the annotator wrote `点出-00`, but CPB has `点出-01` (ARG0 agent, ARG1 theme).
- 有能力: the annotator wrote `有-01`. Gold has `有-06` ("ARG1 entity owned by / exist with respect to arg0").
- 合成照片: the annotator wrote `:mod (合成)`. Gold has `(照片 :ARG1-of (合成-01 :aspect performance))`, with `(注销 :overlap 合成)` and `(author :full-affirmative 合成)`. CPB has 合成-01.
- 握手的照片: the annotator wrote `:topic 握手 :aspect performance`. Gold has `:mod (握手-01 :aspect process)`.
- 注销: gold uses `注销-00`, because CPB 注销-01 ("cancel") does not fit the meaning "posted/published" here.

**Change.**
- Extend the "Chinese adjectives are verbs" rule to participial and verbal modifiers: a verb before 的 or a bare verb + N (合成照片) → `N :ARG1-of (V-01 :aspect performance)` when the noun is the result or patient.
- An event noun in 的 before a noun (握手的照片) → `:mod (V-01 :aspect process)`.
- Ability or possession of an abstract quality (有能力) → `有-06`.
- If the CPB sense does not match the meaning in context, use `-00`.
- Repeat the instruction "look up every predicate, including V+出/V+到 compounds".

## 6. Smaller patterns, each worth adding as one line

- **如 introducing an example sentence** (sentence 18, 3 units: event_found, entity_found, plus the missing 全 node). Add: `(have-example-91 :ARG1 (implicit-predicate) :ARG2 <main event>)` as the root.
- **全世界, 复制人.** Gold splits them: `(世界 :mod (全))`, and `(人 :ARG1-of (复制-01 :aspect process))` with `(author :full-affirmative 复制)`. Add: "a compound V+N noun where N is the patient (复制人) → `N :ARG1-of V`; 全+N → `N :mod (全)`."
- **Sentence-initial 为了 X，Y** (sentence 19). Gold uses `(have-reason-91 :ARG1 报导 :ARG2 讽刺)` with 讽刺 `:aspect performance`, not `:purpose` with `activity`. This contradicts the instruction's 为了 → `:purpose` / activity rule. It is one sentence, so treat it with caution. A clause-initial 为了 that fronts a whole clause could be handled like the paired-connective rule (an abstract-predicate root). If you adopt that, its aspect follows the realized event (`performance`), not `activity`.
- **外交政策.** Gold has `政策 :topic (外交)`, not `:mod`.
- **Locative noun with an institution name** (sentence 20, 美国参议院记者团的墙上). Gold has `(墙上 :place-of (记者团 :place (building …)))`. Keep the locative word whole (墙上). Extend "a country name modifying a noun is `:place`" to institution names, and do not use `:possessor` for them.

## What the annotator got right and the instruction should keep

- **Publication titles after 一篇** (sentences 18, 19, 20): `publication :name` with brackets as `:opN`, `:quant 1 :unit (篇)`. Also the 新闻 `:ARG1-of identity-91 :ARG2 publication` apposition.
- **The 该刊 → `(刊 :mod (该))` rule.**
- **`:part-of`** for 周报内容 and for 该刊的新闻.
- **Pronoun handling:** 它 → `thing`, 他们 → `person` plural. The coreference chain (each mention linked back to a 刊 / 周报 mention) scored 100.
- **`but-91` for 虽然…但.**
- **CPB adjectives as events:** 荒唐-01, 荒谬-01, 可笑-01, `显著-01 :ARG0-of`, 真实-01.
- **好事者** → `(者 :ARG0-of (好事-00 :aspect state))`.
- **指-02 / 当选-01 / 背书-00** with `:reason` (the 靠 rule), and the 1992 date-entity.
- **Modality:** `neutral-affirmative` for 点出 under 有能力.
- **Document format:** all correct.
reflect（说明和提出的修改）
## Summary of changes

These edits fix the five costly patterns in the critique. They keep the rules that worked: titles after 一篇, 该刊, `:part-of`, pronouns, `but-91` and CPB adjectives. To stay under the 30,000-character limit, I deleted some low-value text: the "two levels" overview, the `:mode` line (rare in news), the AMR type list and two redundant aspect examples.

1. **「…」 titles.** A 「…」 is a `publication` only after 一篇/篇 or an article noun (新闻, 文章, 标题). As the direct object of a reporting verb (报导「…」) it is reported content: a full clause with events, arguments, aspect, modal and temporal triples, and `:quote`.
2. **Temporal anchoring.**
   - A named event + 时, and a date inside reported content, get no temporal parent.
   - A 时-clause event is the child of the main event.
   - In `and`-coordination, the time phrase stays on the first conjunct only, and each conjunct hangs from the one before it.
   - 靠 X V is `:overlap`; reason-before-result applies only to 因为/由于.
   - Under `but-91`/`contrast-91`, the `:ARG1` clause is anchored and the `:ARG2` event hangs from it with `:overlap`.
3. **Reported speech.**
   - The speaker conceives its own reporting events: `(author :full-affirmative 刊) (刊 :full-affirmative 指)`.
   - The content events of 报导/指 get `author` only.
   - Every content event carries `:quote`.
   - The 宣称 claim case keeps its rule (top content node gets both `author` and speaker triples).
4. **`identity-91` in a noun phrase.** When it equates a noun with a title or content (新闻「…」, 能力 + V), it gets `:aspect state` and an `author` modal triple. 能力 + V uses `identity-91`, not `:topic`.
5. **Senses and verbal modifiers.**
   - 合成照片 → `照片 :ARG1-of 合成-01`; 握手的照片 → `:mod (握手-01 :aspect process)`.
   - 复制人 → `人 :ARG1-of 复制-01`; 全世界 → `世界 :mod (全)`.
   - 有能力 → `有-06`; 点出 → `点出-01` (look up V+出 compounds).
   - When no CPB sense fits the meaning in context, use `-00` (注销-00).
6. **Small additions.** A 如-example sentence gets a `have-example-91` root. An institution name before a locative noun is `:place`. 外交政策 → `:topic`.

critique
The annotation is strong overall: event senses 100, name tokens 100, coreference chains 100, document format 100. Most of what was lost comes from one reported clause in sentence 16, from missing shared subjects, and from a few rules where the instruction disagrees with the gold. Here they are, most costly first.

## 1. Inner structure of a 报导「…」 clause (snt16): about 9 units
**Checks hit:** d_core_args ×2, e_core_labels ×1, g_reentrancy (3 extra), c_aspect ×1, i_modal ×1.

In 「外星人 支持 布什 当 总统」 the annotator wrote:
- `支持-01 :ARG1 布什 :ARG2 (当-02 :ARG0 布什 :quote 报导 :aspect performance)`;
- a `:quote s16b` on 支持 as well;
- `(author :full-affirmative 当)`.

The gold is:
```
(报导-01 :ARG1 (支持-01 :ARG0 (外星人) :ARG1 (当-02 :ARG0 (individual-person :name 布什) :ARG1 (总统)) :aspect state) :quote s16x …)
```
- 当 has no `:aspect` and no modal triple.
- Neither content event has `:quote`. The gold puts `:quote` on 报导 itself, pointing to itself.

**Why it happened:**
- The instruction never says to take role numbers from the CPB frame for this case. PropBank 支持-01 has only ARG0 and ARG1, so "支持 X 当 Y" must be `:ARG1 (当 :ARG0 X)`. The annotator gave it an English-style ARG1 + ARG2.
- Rule 2.2 says "each event `:quote <report>`" for a 「…」 object of a reporting verb. That is what produced the extra `:quote` edges. The gold applies `:quote` per event only to 指 content, not to 报导「…」.

**Change:**
- Add: "支持/帮助/让 X V: X is the `:ARG0` of V, and the whole V-clause is `:ARG1` of 支持. 支持-01 has no `:ARG2`. Look the frame up."
- Add: "An event embedded as a complement inside another content event (当 under 支持) gets no `:aspect` and no modal triple."
- Revise 2.2 for 报导「…」: put `:quote` on the 报导 node itself (as the gold does) and none on the content events. Keep per-event `:quote 指` for 指/宣称 content.

## 2. Shared subject left out of a controlled or purpose event: 4 units
**Checks hit:** g_reentrancy missing ×2, d_core_args.

- **有能力点出:** the annotator gave `点出-01` no `:ARG0`. Gold: `点出-01 :ARG0 s17x5 (编辑)`.
- **为了讽刺…，他们…报导:** the annotator gave `讽刺-01` no `:ARG0`. Gold: `讽刺-01 :ARG0 s19p (他们)`.

**Why:** the instruction says "Never re-use a participant … as an unexpressed agent", and its exception lists only 继续/停止/开始/想/打算.

**Change:** extend that exception to 有能力/有资格 + V (the 有-06 subject is the V's `:ARG0`) and to a 为了/为 purpose clause whose subject is the main clause's subject.

## 3. Sentence-initial 为了 X，Y (snt19): about 5 units
**Checks hit:** a_event_found, d_peripheral, c_aspect, a_entity_found ×2.

- The annotator wrote `报导 :purpose (讽刺 :aspect activity)`.
- Gold: `(have-reason-91 :ARG1 (报导-01 … :mod (也)) :ARG2 (讽刺-01 :ARG0 他们 :aspect performance))`, with no `:aspect` or modal triple on have-reason-91. The 也 node was also missed.

**Why:**
- Rule 2.5 maps 为了 → `:purpose` and reserves have-*-91 roots for paired connectives.
- Rule 4.1 forces purpose events to `activity`.

**Change:**
- Add: "A clause-initial 为了 X，Y with a completed main event → `(have-reason-91 :ARG1 Y :ARG2 X)`."
- Add: "A purpose that the completed main event achieves (satirizing by reporting) is `performance`."
- Restate: 也 → `:mod (也)` whenever it is the clause's only adverb, even when a 为了 clause comes before it.
- (The gold's `:quant`/`:unit` on 也 looks like noise; don't copy it.)

## 4. Repeated generic noun reused by re-entrancy (snt16): 3 units
The annotator wrote `背书-00 :ARG0 s16x`, reusing the first 外星人. Gold makes a new node: `(背书-00 :ARG0 (s16x16 / 外星人))`.

**Why:** rule 3 says "refer to it at later exact repeats in the same sentence by its bare variable."

**Change:** limit that rule to named or specific referents. A bare kind noun (外星人, 人) that is repeated in a different clause gets its own node.

## 5. Abstract-predicate defaults applied to have-example-91 (snt18): 2 units
The annotator gave `have-example-91` `:aspect state` and `(author :full-affirmative s18h)`. Gold has neither.

**Change:** "have-example-91 (如 + example) gets no `:aspect`, no temporal parent and no modal triple; its `:ARG2` event is anchored as the main event."

## 6. Aspect and temporal links of noun-modifying events: 3 units
- **复制人 (generic kind):** the annotator had `复制-01 :aspect performance` plus `(争论 :overlap 复制)`. Gold: `:aspect process` and no temporal parent.
- **合成照片:** the annotator had `(注销 :before 合成)`. Gold: `(注销 :overlap 合成)`. The "resultative participle comes before" rule was over-extended from 遗留下来.

**Change:**
- Add: "V+N naming a kind (复制人) → V `:aspect process`, no temporal parent."
- Add: "A V+N for a specific object (合成照片) → `performance` and `:overlap` its governing event. Use `:before` only for an explicit 下来/出来 resultative."

## 7. Smaller items: 1 unit each
- **墙上:** the annotator wrote `墙`. Gold keeps `墙上` as written. Add: a locative noun that is the place argument of a verb (贴到 墙上) keeps 上 in the concept. Only frames like 历史上/在…上 get split into `(上 :op1 …)`.
- **可笑's temporal parent (snt17):** the annotator used `荒谬 :overlap 可笑`. Gold: `点出 :overlap 可笑`. The "each `:opN` hangs from `:opN-1`" rule should apply to coordinated clauses only. Adjective conjuncts inside an argument hang from the governing event.

## What to keep
These rules produced exactly the gold and should stay as written:
- **Headline titles:** `publication` with 「」 tokens, `:quant 1 :unit (篇)`.
- **新闻 + title:** `新闻 :ARG1-of (identity-91 :ARG2 publication :aspect state)`, with an author modal triple and no temporal parent.
- **有能力 V:** `有-06` + `能力 :ARG1-of identity-91`, the V `habitual` and `neutral-affirmative`.
- **指 reports:** 指-02 with `:quote` on its content, `(指 :before 当选)`, and the speaker 刊 as conceiver of 报导, 注销 and 指.
- **Adjectives and V+者 forms:** 荒唐-01, 显著-01 and 好事-00 for 好事者.
- **Coordinated adjectives:** `and` of 荒谬-01 and 可笑-01, sharing 新闻.
- **Pronoun nodes** and the coreference chain of 周报/它/他们/该刊.
- **Institution names:** `building` for 美国参议院 plus the `:place-of` structure.
- **Named-event dates:** `event :name` for 2000年总统大选.
reflect（说明和提出的修改）
I made seven targeted fixes, plus space-saving deletions to stay under the 30,000-character limit.

1. **报导「…」 clauses.** For 报导, `:quote` now goes on the 报导 node itself, pointing to itself, and on none of the content events. Content of 指, 宣称 and 说 keeps per-event `:quote`.
2. **支持/帮助/让 X V.** These now follow the CPB frame: X is the `:ARG0` of V, and the whole V-clause is `:ARG1`. 支持-01 has no `:ARG2`. An event that is a complement inside another content event (当 under 支持) gets no `:aspect` and no modal triple.
3. **Shared subjects.** The control exception now also covers 有能力/有资格 + V. It also covers a 为了/为 purpose clause, whose `:ARG0` is the main-clause subject.
4. **Clause-initial 为了 X，Y with a completed main event.** This becomes `have-reason-91` with no aspect, temporal parent or modal triple on it, and X is `performance`. The 也 node is kept even when a 为了 clause comes before it.
5. **Repeated nouns.** The same-sentence re-entrancy rule is limited to named or specific referents. A bare kind noun repeated in another clause gets its own node.
6. **have-example-91.** It gets no aspect, temporal parent or modal triple.
7. **V+N modifiers and smaller items.**
   - A specific V+N object is `performance` and `:overlap` its governing event.
   - A V+N naming a kind is `process` with no temporal parent.
   - `:before` is only for explicit 下来/出来 resultatives.
   - A locative place argument keeps 上 in its concept (墙上).
   - Coordinated adjectives inside an argument hang from the governing event.

To make room, I deleted several old examples whose rules are already stated in the text, and added short examples for each new fix.

next sentence 他们 → `(s12n :same-entity s13p)`.@@ -278,3 +278,7 @@ - Title (2.2): 刊登一篇「苏联复制…」 → `(刊登-01 :ARG2 (publication :name (name :op1 "「" :op2 "苏联" … "」") :quant 1 :unit (篇)))`, no events inside. - Adjective (2.1): 内容虽然荒唐 → `(荒唐-01 :ARG0 (内容 :part-of 周报) :aspect state)`. - Report (5.1, 5.2): 指柯林顿1992年靠外星人背书当选 → `(当选-01 :ARG0 柯林顿 :reason (背书-00 :ARG0 外星人))`, `(指 :before 当选)`, `(刊 :full-affirmative 指) (author :full-affirmative 当选)`.++- 报导「…」 (2.2, 3): 报导「外星人支持布什当总统」 → `(报导-01 :quote <itself> :ARG1 (支持-01 :ARG0 (外星人) :ARG1 (当-02 :ARG0 布什 :ARG1 (总统))))`; 当 no aspect/modal; a later 外星人 is a new node.+- 为了 (2.5): 为了讽刺…，他们也…报导 → `(have-reason-91 :ARG1 (报导-01 :mod (也)) :ARG2 (讽刺-01 :ARG0 他们 :aspect performance))`; 有能力点出 → `点出 :ARG0 编辑`.+- V+N (2.1): 合成照片 → `(注销 :overlap 合成)`; 复制人 → `复制-01 :aspect process`, no temporal parent; have-example-91 bare.

逐文件结果与文件链接

每一行是一次运行的一篇文件，链接到 GitHub 上的：模型的回答原文（.raw.txt）；解析结果（.umr：把回答解析、补上自动对齐、文档级关系分到各句后，按 shared task 格式写出的文件，打分用的就是它）；实际发出的 prompt；完整对话；解析时记下的问题（.trace.json 的 parse.problems）；这次运行的分数（scores.md）。

prompt 的第一版（Claude API，中文，juːmæʧ F）
条件v1：原 prompt（要模型写对齐）v2：现在的 prompt（不写对齐，强调尽量正确、多查）差v1 结果目录
s1-abridged：缩略版 guideline49.449.0-0.4目录
s1-full：完整 guideline44.749.3+4.6目录
s2-search：缩略版 + guideline 搜索49.050.0+1.0目录
s2-propbank：缩略版 + PropBank47.548.1+0.5目录
s2-gold：缩略版 + gold 例子48.849.5+0.7目录

v1 的回答在这里去掉模型自己写的对齐、改用自动对齐重新打分，所以两列可以直接比较。只改措辞，同一篇的分数就会变 0.4–4.6 分，可以当作随机波动的一个参考。

局限

  • 3 篇文件、每个条件跑一次：没有量过同一条件重复跑的波动，也没有置信区间。
  • effort 都是 medium；Claude 查资源的次数很少，资源条件的对照因此偏弱。
  • juːmæʧ 依赖自动对齐：gold 的图配自动对齐，中文 87.4、英文 65.9（英文 gold 自己的对齐有不少错位），英文的 juːmæʧ 因此偏低；Smatch 和 AnCast++ 不受对齐影响。
